summary: Both backend and frontend of DÇK-EÖS Fiyat Endeksi tested end-to-end. Backend pytest smoke suite (16/16) passes locally and public /api/meta and /api/tree return 200 with correct shape. Frontend: all 7 screens load with expected data-testids present, and — most importantly — the Kırılım (COICOP) node-selection flow that the main agent could not verify is FULLY WORKING: clicking tree-node-01 updates selected-count from 0/6 → 1/6, right-hand detail panel renders (Ağırlık 24.40%, Değişim %+1,22, Durum Taze), tabs (tab-chart/tab-sources/tab-items) appear, chart renders, selecting 6 nodes shows 6/6, 7th click triggers data-testid=max-warn, unchecking via tree-check-01 decrements the badge to 5/6, tab-items shows sortable rows (sort-degisim present, 9 item-rows), and clicking an item-row renders data-testid=item-sparkline. No overlay/visual-edits interception seen on the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: post_tuik uses Form(..., alias='from'), but starlette Form does not honour alias for the multipart field name — currently the frontend must send the field named 'from_' or 'from'. Smoke test sends 'from' and it works, so likely accepted; still worth verifying multipart alias handling.
Method endpoint returns raw markdown; frontend must render KaTeX. Confirmed no raw $$ visible in DOM.
FixtureRepository is fine for phase 1 as documented; SqliteRepository stub is intentional (per problem statement).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kırılım selection verified via public URL with data-testid=tree-node-<kod> row click. selected-count badge, right panel stats, tabs, items table, and item-sparkline all wired correctly. Backend smoke suite at /app/backend/tests/test_smoke.py — 16 tests all pass. Global search (data-testid=global-search-input) returns dropdown data-testid=search-results with results for 'ekmek'. Kalite grid has 336 rc-cell testids (24x14).
rca of the issue: Main agent's earlier failure to verify node click was environmental (visual-edits overlay in their harness). On the actual preview URL, tree-node click handler in TreeView.tsx (onClick={()=>onToggle(node.kod)}) fires correctly and Breakdown.tsx toggle() updates state as expected.
